GENERAL WEATHER FORECAST FOR NEXT 36 HOURS
Issued at 04.00 p.m. on 16 December 2025
Under the influence of the Easterly wave, the prevailing showery conditions over the Northern
and Eastern parts of the island are expected to continue further during the next few days.
Tonight:
Showers will occur at times in Northern, North-Central, Eastern, Uva and Central provinces.
Fairly heavy falls above 50 mm are likely at some places in Northern and Eastern provinces and
in Polonnaruwa district.
Showers or thundershowers may occur at a few places in the other areas of the island.
Tomorrow:
Showers will occur at times in Northern, North-Central, Eastern, Uva and Central provinces.
Heavy falls above 100 mm are likely at some places in Eastern and Central provinces and in
Badulla and Polonnaruwa districts.
Showers or thundershowers may occur at several places in the other areas of the island after
1.00 p.m. Fairly heavy falls above 75 mm are likely at some places in these areas.
Strong winds of about (40-50) kmph can be expected at times over Eastern slopes of the central
hills, Northern, North-central and North-western provinces and in Trincomalee, Hambantota
and Monaragala districts.
Misty conditions can be expected at some places in Sabaragamuwa and Central provinces and
in Galle and Matara districts during the early hours of the morning.
The general public is kindly requested to take adequate precautions to minimize damages caused by
temporary localized strong winds and lightning during thundershowers.
Rainfall amount (mm): Light: 00-12.5, Light to moderate: 12.5-25, Moderate: 25-50, Fairly heavy rain: 50 -100,
Heavy rain: 100 – 150, Very heavy rain: 150 or more.
